text:
emma: perf-bot alerted: PR #6021 failed perf/unit microbench_batched_latency on linux-gpu. Threshold diff +11.8% (allowed <=5%). CI artifact: https://ci.redwood.internal/6021/artifacts/bench-report.html
perf-bot: Alert summary: microbench_batched_latency +11.8%, p95 latency +35ms, kv-hit -2.9%.
ci-bot: Triggered by merge-base 5e3a7f2 -> changed files: runtime/batcher.cpp, runtime/kernel_selector.cc, tests/perf/microbench.cpp
carl: ack. Reassigning — @aj can you take a look at the batcher/kernel_selector changes? This smells like enqueue-wait or bad kernel choice.
aj: looking now. Local repro shows increased tail latency. Uploading flamegraph: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/flames/6021-flame.svg
sophia: ran a local microbench: `bench --bench=batcher_throughput --tokens=32 --model=llama-7b-quant`
Baseline (main): 1300 tok/s -> PR 1160 tok/s (~-10.8%). `pprof` top: `batcher::dispatch` ~30%, `kernel_selector::choose` ~20%, `gpu_kernel_launcher` ~25%.
kevin: I reviewed kernel_selector diff at 5e3a7f2 — it changed heuristic to prefer fused kernels for seq_len <= 64. Maybe fused path has more setup overhead for small batches and is slower for our short-seq workload.
aj: bisect indicates 5e3a7f2 is the likely culprit. Quick local revert of that heuristic restores perf to ~1295 tok/s.
emma: if revert is that straightforward, let's block the rollout until we have a safe fix. Flagging as potential rollout blocker. :warning:
ryan: alternative: add a lightweight fast-path for very small batch sizes instead of full revert. Quick idea:
```cpp
if (seq_len <= 64 && batch_size < 8) {
  return select_lightweight_kernel();
}
```
I'll try that in a canary.
aj: also noticed kv cache hitrate dropped ~3% in the failing CI run vs baseline. Could be due to batching order change affecting key hashing. Lower kv-hit would increase compute and explain some of the delta.
sophia: good catch — I'll instrument kv hits in the microbench harness and run 3 repeats to confirm.
ci-bot: Regression summary: PR 6021 -> microbench +11.8% (regression), kv-hit -2.9%, p95 +35ms. Full diff: https://ci.redwood.internal/6021/artifacts/regression-diff.txt
emma: proposed plan:
1) revert kernel_selector heuristic in PR 6021 (temporary) to unblock release
2) add a microbench unit test covering short sequences / small batches to catch this in CI
3) open a follow-up to design a better cost model for fused vs lightweight kernels and address KV ordering impact
I will submit the revert PR now.
aj: thanks — I'll prepare a canary with Ryan's lightweight fast-path and run perf smoke.
carl: marking PR #6021 as rollback-needed and updating release board. :white_check_mark:
sophia: after revert and new tests, I'll run a full matrix (seq_len x batch_size) to build a small perf regression table we can add to PR checks.
emma: thanks everyone — good triage. Keep updates in this thread and paste canary perf numbers when ready.
